stem: A particle starts from the origin at t = 0 with a velocity of $\overrightarrow{u} = 8\widehat{j}$ m/s and moves in the xy plane with a constant acceleration of $\overrightarrow{a} = 4\widehat{i} + 2\widehat{j}$ m/s<sup>2</sup>. At the instant the particle’s x–coordinate is 32 m, what are (i) its y–coordinate and (ii) its speed?

assets.alt: x–y axes: a path starting vertically at the origin (initial velocity u) and curving right to (32, 48), where the velocity is v = 16î + 16ĵ.
